title: Narrow an untrusted webhook body into a typed event
acceptanceCriteria: Valid `signup`, `payment` and `cancel` bodies parse with `ok: true` and every field intact
A payment whose `amountCents` is the string `"1200"` is rejected
A body with an unknown `kind` is rejected instead of being passed through
`feedLine` describes a cancel as `"u1 cancelled: too expensive"`, or `"u2 cancelled"` without a reason
`feedLine` throws for a `kind` that isn't in `AppEvent`, instead of returning a fallback line
